configurations.//: Attaches to the dev server rather than starting one. `npm run dev` (scripts/dev.mjs) spawns two processes — uvicorn on 8765 and vite on 5173 — and both ports are pinned: 8765 in the spawn args, 5173 in vite.config.ts, which also proxies /api to the backend. So a second copy is not a matter of picking a free port; autoPort would move vite and leave uvicorn colliding on 8765. Start it yourself with `npm run dev` and this previews it.
configurations.name: bol-dev
